stem: Which sentence best summarizes paragraphs 4 through 7?

options.label: A
options.text: Older children walked beside the wagons and gathered wood as the wagons rolled along.

options.label: B
options.text: Younger children rode in the wagons with their mothers.

options.label: C
options.text: Pioneer children were often given duties to help their families.

options.label: D
options.text: Children encountered many dangers while traveling across the prairie.
